name: gwbasic-2026
description: Syntax highlighting, snippets, and run/compile tasks for Microsoft GW-BASIC, backed by the gw-basic-2026 interpreter and AOT compiler.

commands.title: Run current file
commands.enablement: isWorkspaceTrusted && (resourceScheme == file || resourceScheme == vscode-remote) && editorLangId == gwbasic

commands.title: Compile current file (AOT)
commands.enablement: isWorkspaceTrusted && (resourceScheme == file || resourceScheme == vscode-remote) && editorLangId == gwbasic

keybindings.when: editorTextFocus && editorLangId == gwbasic && isWorkspaceTrusted && (resourceScheme == file || resourceScheme == vscode-remote) && !inDebugMode

gwbasic.interpreterPath.description: Executable name on PATH or path to gwbasic. Relative paths resolve from the file’s workspace folder. Do not add shell quotes or arguments.

gwbasic.compilerPath.description: Executable name on PATH or path to gwbasic-compile. Relative paths resolve from the file’s workspace folder. Do not add shell quotes or arguments.

gwbasic.compileArgs.description: Compiler argument array, one entry per argument. Default -c creates an executable next to the source. An explicit --runtime argument overrides runtimePath. Relative argument paths use the source directory.

gwbasic.runtimePath.description: Built repository or extracted Linux release containing include/gwrt.h and build/libgwrt.a. Empty: detect beside an explicit compiler path, then in the file’s workspace folder. Relative paths resolve from that folder.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Highlighting and snippets work; running and compiling programs require Workspace Trust.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Run and Compile need files and executables on the extension host.
